hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json,re,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command','')
if re.search(r'(^|;|&&|\|)\s*git\s+(fetch|pull)\b.*\bupstream\b', cmd):
    if '--no-tags' not in cmd or not re.search(r'\bmain\b', cmd):
        print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','permissionDecision':'deny','permissionDecisionReason':'git fetch/pull from the upstream remote must target only main and include --no-tags (see .claude/rules/git-upstream-fetch.md)'}}))
"
